q1_issues.issue: The 'until tomorrow' adjunct modifies the postponing but is emitted as a `Time` on the postponed final, dropping the surface 'until' — the instruction set maps 'until Y' to an interval `(End <event> <term>)` on the eventuality it modifies and licenses no re-attachment of the adjunct to the Patient.

q2_gaps: 'until / to <time>' naming the NEW scheduled time of a postponed or rescheduled occurrence — the Time section covers 'until Y' only as an interval End and 'by T' only as a deadline TimeAtMost, and gives no form for a rescheduling destination time
notes: Patient for the postponed occurrence is exactly the stated rule that postpone/delay/reschedule is never read as displacement-in-time, and the agentless passive, Past, and bare deictic constant `tomorrow` are all correct. A side effect of the chosen attachment is that sk_final_1 carries a Time with no status atom, which reads as the generic/habitual default.
